introduction: Utah WIC starts through the local clinic by call or text. A nutrition appointment determines eligibility before the clinic issues a WIC card.
description: Utah WIC starts through the local clinic by call or text. A nutrition appointment determines eligibility before the clinic issues a WIC card.

sections.who: WIC serves qualifying pregnant, postpartum or breastfeeding people and children younger than five. Income, local residence and nutrition conditions apply; the clinic assesses certification periods.
sections.get: Supplemental foods and nutrition services rather than a complete food budget.
sections.docs:
• Identity for each applicant.
  • Address evidence.
  • Income or qualifying Medicaid, SNAP or FEP records.
sections.apply:
1. Contact your local clinic

    Use Utah WIC’s clinic links.

  2. Prepare for the appointment

    Ask which records to bring for each person applying.

  3. Complete nutrition review

    Discuss health and food needs and learn the card rules if approved.
sections.after: Follow clinic appointments and certification instructions. Ask staff about variable or self-employment income documentation.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using WIC application, records and nutrition assessment, Supplemental benefit purpose. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Does immigration status determine WIC eligibility?
Utah WIC says citizenship and immigration status do not affect eligibility.
Can I show electronic pay records?
The clinic guidance allows electronic income verification shown on a device.
Does Medicaid mean enrollment is complete?
It can establish income eligibility, but clinic assessment remains necessary.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
